# Results summary (generated by scripts/summarize.py)

ResNet-18 W8A8, 21 layers (20 CONV_2D + 1 FC), 1814.1 MMAC = 100% of the network's MACs. Dynamic instructions of the kernel only (Spike PC histogram, validated against the full -l trace). Every cell is bit-exact vs the TFLite interpreter.

## Whole network (sum of all layers)

| Config | Description | Dyn. insns | MAC/insn | ld+st/MAC | vs B0 | vs B1 | step gain |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| B0 | baseline RV64IMC | 12859666728 | 0.141 | 2.015 | 1.00x | 0.58x |  |
| B1 | software-optimised (2-ch tile, 4x unroll) | 7428739832 | 0.244 | 1.519 | 1.73x | 1.00x | 1.73x |
| X0 | B1 loop + qmac8, software requant | 1177736736 | 1.540 | 0.202 | 10.92x | 6.31x | 6.31x |
| X1 | X0 + qreq | 1057733279 | 1.715 | 0.195 | 12.16x | 7.02x | 1.11x |
| X2 | X1 + ldpi (post-increment load) | 714417433 | 2.539 | 0.195 | 18.00x | 10.40x | 1.48x |

Incremental: **qmac8** (B1->X0) = 6.31x, **qreq** (X0->X1) = 1.11x, both (B1->X1) = 7.02x, vs naive baseline (B0->X1) = 12.16x.

Extension X2: **ldpi** (X1->X2) = 1.48x, both-to-end B1->X2 = 10.40x, B0->X2 = 18.00x.

## Targets from the project brief

- >=2x dynamic-instruction reduction on a major GEMM/FC kernel: min over layers B1->X1 = 6.44x (op14), max = 7.10x (op32); vs B0: min 10.24x, max 12.40x. **Met** for every layer.
- End-to-end >=1.5x: this table is an *instruction-count* ratio of the conv/FC kernels only (7.02x vs B1, 12.16x vs B0). The whole chained model, including pad/pool/add/transpose/im2col, is in model_summary.md (scripts/summarize_model.py). Neither is a cycle or wall-clock speedup.
